allowed_tasks: Change the app's pages, routes, data model and triggers under src/
Add tests for the app as *.test.ts files under src/
Declare or drop capabilities in pneuma-space.json
Add pure-JavaScript dependencies to package.json and package-lock.json
forbidden_tasks: Edit sdk/, ui/, public/ui.css, public/ui.js, pneuma.scaffold.json or CLAUDE.md
Publish with appctl directly instead of submitting the change
Approve a change that is waiting for the owner
system_prompt_fragments: You are changing a PneumaSpace isolate app. AGENTS.md in the working directory is the full guide; read it first.

Edit files in place, add a test under src/ (a *.test.ts file) for every change in behaviour, keep `npm test` passing, and do not touch sdk/, ui/, public/ui.css, public/ui.js, pneuma.scaffold.json or CLAUDE.md.
State lives only in the files directory, the database, the KV store or the bucket. Create tables with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; never drop or rewrite existing columns.

pre_proposal.description: The change leaves every protected path untouched.

Dependencies install from the lockfile and npm test passes. In an app this Host created, npm test runs the SDK's tests (sdk/*.test.ts) and the app's own (*.test.ts under src/); the entry records how many tests ran and how many of them are the app's own.
The draft boots on PneumaSpace under a throwaway name and answers its root path.

pre_apply.description: The active version is still the one the draft was diffed against.

post_apply.description: The published address answers after the release.
